lines.text: ChatGPT just stopped answering with only text.
With GPT-6, OpenAI added Intelligent UI: answers with tappable buttons, forms, charts and graphics.
Here are three things it can do.
Number 3. Ask for a recipe, and the cooking timeline sits right next to it. Plan a road trip, and the stops land on a map.
Number 2. It builds small tools on request, like a bill splitter or a savings calculator, or even a game you play inside the chat.
Number 1. It doesn't wait to finish. A compiler builds the interface while the answer is still being written.
Simple question? You still get plain text.
Paid plans got it on October 7, and Free and Go users from the very next day.
